title: Relay page recovery fails when a different mailbox is missing its home association
outcome: Cold-cache native relay page recovery resolves the requested mailbox independently of association loss in other mailboxes visible to the same caller.
acceptance: On the authenticated original home, a cold-cache page read for a known mailbox works when another mailbox of the same caller has proven association loss.
A cold-cache page read for an unknown locator returns the typed unknown-locator refusal in the same fixture. The other mailbox is neither repaired nor disclosed.
